step_up.title: Verify it is you
step_up.area.signatures: Your department asks you to verify it is you before you sign.
step_up.area.acknowledgments: Your department asks you to verify it is you before your acknowledgment is recorded.
step_up.area.approvals: Your department asks you to verify it is you before you approve.
step_up.area.protected_data: Verify it is you to see protected information.
step_up.enroll_needed: Your department requires two-factor authentication for this, and you have not set it up yet.
step_up.approval_hint: Approve the request in Responder on your other device, and check that it shows this number.
step_up.use_sso: Sign in again with your organization
step_up.errors.invalid_code: That code is not right. Check your authenticator app and try again.
step_up.errors.invalid_password: That password is not right. Try again.
step_up.errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
step_up.errors.password_not_available: Your account signs in with your organization, so a password cannot be used here. Choose another way.
step_up.errors.enrollment_required: Set up two-factor authentication first, then try again.
step_up.errors.session_required: Your session needs to be renewed. Sign out, sign in again, then try again.
step_up.errors.approval_pending: The approval is still waiting. Approve it in Responder, then try again.
step_up.errors.approval_denied: The request was declined in Responder.
step_up.errors.approval_expired: The approval request expired. Try again.
step_up.errors.sso_not_satisfied: Your organization did not ask you to sign in again. Try again, or choose another way.
step_up.errors.provider_not_satisfied: Your organization did not confirm the verification. Try again, or choose another way.
step_up.errors.method_not_allowed: Your department does not allow this way to verify. Choose another way.
step_up.errors.unavailable: Verification is not available right now. Try again shortly.
step_up.errors.passkey_unavailable: A passkey cannot be used right now. Choose another way.
step_up.errors.sso_cancelled: Signing in with your organization was cancelled.
step_up.errors.network: No network connection. Connect, then try again.
step_up.errors.failed: Verification did not succeed. Try again.
